info.title: RideResolve Multi-Agent Read-Only Tools
info.description: Read-only tools for synthetic RideResolve cases. The secure connector credential is a short-lived, role-specific run token and must never appear in model input.

post.summary: Get the case summary authorized for this probe run
post.description: Use first. Evidence IDs are intentionally omitted so evidence citations must come from get_trip_evidence.

post.summary: Get selected evidence authorized for this probe run
post.description: Returns only evidence in the server-side run manifest. Prefer DECISION_FACTS; request SUMMARY or FULL only for human audit.

post.summary: Get policy rules authorized for this probe run
post.description: The policy version and dispute type come from the server-side run manifest.

scope.description: Return the current run's policy rules for its locked dispute type.

post.summary: Search approved advisory precedents for this run
post.description: Policy context and matched rules are derived server-side from the locked case snapshot. Results are advisory-only and cannot override policy.

post.summary: Evaluate the locked run with deterministic policy code
post.description: Workflow-owned gate operation. Official case data and its pinned policy version take precedence over legacy mock assumptions.

post.summary: Reject a Judge recommendation that conflicts with the locked run
post.description: Workflow-owned final gate. It verifies run identity, citations, status, action, amount, currency, and the deterministic policy result.

oneOf.description: Serialized JudgeRecommendation accepted for ADP transport. The service unwraps one additional JSON-string transport layer before applying the same strict validation.

RunToken.name: X-RideResolve-Run-Token
RunToken.description: Short-lived role-specific credential configured only in the connector secret store.
